schema.subject: teammate-subagent-definition-behavior

experimental_flag.name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS
experimental_flag.description: Agent teams are disabled by default. Must be set to enable the feature.

configuration_options.option: Set in the shell environment before launching Claude Code.

source.excerpt: "Agent teams are disabled by default. Enable them by setting the CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS environment variable to 1, either in your shell environment or through settings.json"

schema.teammate_field: field: tools type: list applicability: cli honored_when_teammate: true description: | The subagent definition's tools allowlist is honored when the definition runs as a teammate. The teammate is restricted to the listed tools, with the exception that team coordination tools (SendMessage and task management tools) are always available regardless of this list. excerpt: "The teammate honors that definition's tools allowlist and model" caveat: | Team coordination tools (SendMessage and task management tools) are always available even when tools restricts other tools. source: url: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams section: Use subagent definitions for teammates fetched_at: 2026-04-16T10:15:00-04:00

field: model type: string applicability: cli honored_when_teammate: true description: | The subagent definition's model field is honored when the definition runs as a teammate. The teammate uses the specified model. excerpt: "The teammate honors that definition's tools allowlist and model" source: url: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams section: Use subagent definitions for teammates fetched_at: 2026-04-16T10:15:00-04:00

field: body (definition body / system prompt content) type: string (markdown body of the subagent definition file) applicability: cli honored_when_teammate: modified description: | The definition's body is applied when running as a teammate, but with modified semantics: it is appended to the teammate's system prompt as additional instructions rather than replacing the system prompt entirely. excerpt: "the definition's body is appended to the teammate's system prompt as additional instructions rather than replacing it" source: url: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams section: Use subagent definitions for teammates fetched_at: 2026-04-16T10:15:00-04:00

field: skills type: list applicability: cli honored_when_teammate: false description: | The skills field in a subagent definition is silently ignored when the definition runs as a teammate. Teammates load skills from project and user settings instead, the same as a regular session. excerpt: "The skills and mcpServers frontmatter fields in a subagent definition are not applied when that definition runs as a teammate. Teammates load skills and MCP servers from your project and user settings, the same as a regular session." caveat: "silently ignored when used as teammate" source: url: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams section: Use subagent definitions for teammates fetched_at: 2026-04-16T10:15:00-04:00

field: mcpServers type: list applicability: cli honored_when_teammate: false description: | The mcpServers field in a subagent definition is silently ignored when the definition runs as a teammate. Teammates load MCP servers from project and user settings instead, the same as a regular session. excerpt: "The skills and mcpServers frontmatter fields in a subagent definition are not applied when that definition runs as a teammate. Teammates load skills and MCP servers from your project and user settings, the same as a regular session." caveat: "silently ignored when used as teammate" source: url: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams section: Use subagent definitions for teammates fetched_at: 2026-04-16T10:15:00-04:00

field: team_coordination_tools (SendMessage, TaskCreate, TaskGet, TaskList, TaskStop, TaskUpdate) type: implicit / always-available applicability: cli honored_when_teammate: true description: | Team coordination tools — SendMessage and the task management tools — are always available to a teammate even when the tools allowlist restricts other tools. These are not declared in the subagent definition frontmatter; they are injected automatically by the agent teams runtime. excerpt: "Team coordination tools such as SendMessage and the task management tools are always available to a teammate even when tools restricts other tools." source: url: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams section: Use subagent definitions for teammates fetched_at: 2026-04-16T10:15:00-04:00

field: subagent_scope (project / user / plugin / CLI-defined) type: enum applicability: cli honored_when_teammate: true description: | Subagent definitions from any scope — project, user, plugin, or CLI-defined — can be referenced when spawning a teammate. The scope resolution works the same as for regular subagent delegation. excerpt: "you can reference a subagent type from any subagent scope: project, user, plugin, or CLI-defined" source: url: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams section: Use subagent definitions for teammates fetched_at: 2026-04-16T10:15:00-04:00
